spine: A fallback plan first: well-paid careers you could switch to if AI/ML doesn't pan out, ranked by pay evidence and how much of your math/CE/SWE background carries over. Boosters for the current path are optional extras. Certs are one tool among skills, languages, math and portfolio work. catalog.json keeps the evidence current (scripts/catalog.py).
rules: Every course names its deliverable up front: a cert (exam booked before the course starts), a public repo with a write-up, or a result (offer, promotion case, interview loop passed).
Cert courses follow the official exam guide's domains, one domain slice per lesson, and end with a timed practice exam.
Before starting a course, re-check its catalog entries (scripts/catalog.py --course <ID>); exams change codes and retire often.

courses.title: Fallback: quant developer (low-latency C++)
courses.note: WATCH (2026-10-07: remote-only rules out most top firms, which are on-site in a few hubs). Path if that changes: C/C++ major CP101-CP204 + CP403, Harris, Trading and Exchanges (wanted), 8ca4543585 Carver, Systematic Trading (A).

courses.title: Fallback: quant research
courses.note: WATCH (remote-only, no more school). Highest ceiling of the math fallbacks, but top firms treat a PhD as near-baseline, so aim at mid-tier funds and systematic-trading teams. Uses the Statistics major (probability, inference, time series) + probability-puzzle interview prep (Crack, Heard on the Street; Zhou, A Practical Guide to Quantitative Finance Interviews: wanted) + 59fb31351d Boyd & Vandenberghe, Convex Optimization (B).

courses.title: Main fallback: actuary (SOA exams)
courses.note: Recommended main fallback (2026-10-07): exam-gated (you accept years of exams), remote-friendly (consultancies especially), outside the software job market, and the accountable sign-off work is the part least exposed to automation. Your Python/ML is in demand there. Ladder: P -> FM -> ASA (FAM, SRM, ATPA, ...). Exam P overlaps the Statistics major. BLS median $125,770.

courses.title: Math toolkit: optimization and operations research
courses.note: Math that strengthens every fallback (quant, OR, ML): convex optimization (59fb31351d Boyd, B) and linear/integer programming. OR analyst as a job title pays less (BLS median $88,940), so treat this as a skill, not a destination.

courses.title: Second fallback: patent agent (USPTO registration exam)
courses.note: One exam, no law degree: your CE and CS degrees qualify you for the USPTO registration exam. Regulated legal work (filings carry a registered practitioner's name) on software/AI/hardware patents. Median ~$124k. Probe: read the exam's MPEP scope and do one practice exam.

courses.title: Fallback: cloud and AI security
courses.note: Security certs top general IT-pay surveys (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP); add LLM/AI security (prompt injection, model supply chain) as the differentiator.

courses.title: Fallback: cloud / AI solutions architect
courses.note: Customer-facing architect roles pay well and value certs most. AWS Solutions Architect Associate (you already have a 2024 course for it) then Professional, or GCP Professional Cloud Architect.

courses.title: Language: Rust
courses.note: Systems, infra, embedded and crypto roles; reported among the top-paying languages. Primary: The Rust Programming Language (official, free at doc.rust-lang.org/book). Easier after the C/C++ major's CP101.

courses.title: Language: Go
courses.note: The language of cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, Terraform are written in it). Primary: Donovan & Kernighan, The Go Programming Language (wanted) or the official Go tour.

courses.title: Track: embedded and robotics software
courses.note: Uses your computer-engineering degree; edge AI (models on devices) is the bridge from your current work. Path: C/C++ major CP101+CP120, then 28a32b9b90 Holt, Embedded Operating Systems (A) and 35ab9520bd Ganssle, The Art of Designing Embedded Systems (B), plus a microcontroller project.

courses.title: Track: SRE and platform engineering
courses.note: Builds on CKAD; Google's SRE book (free at sre.google) as primary; CKA as the badge.

courses.title: Portfolio and visibility
courses.note: Ongoing: resume and LinkedIn lines after every badge or project, public write-ups, one talk or OSS contribution a year. This is the 'advertise' part.
